title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - 60FPS Hammer Golf Swing Fix

preimages.meaning: 原 fadds f11, f12, f0 (锤子旋转角度累加)。/ Original fadds f11, f12, f0 (hammer spin angle accumulation).

anchors.meaning: 分支会跳过、并由 codecave 原样重放的 subi r8, r8, 0x1。/ The branch skips this subi r8, r8, 0x1 and the codecave replays it exactly once.

license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：仅应在 60 FPS 运行时启用；把锤子旋转攻击的单帧角度步进翻倍，并准确重放被 Hook 跨过的圈数递减指令，目标是恢复 30 FPS 下可正常派生的“正本垒/高尔夫挥击”时机。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Enable only while running at 60 FPS; doubles the hammer spin attack's per-frame angle step and exactly replays the loop-count decrement skipped by the hook, aiming to restore the golf-swing/home-run follow-up timing available at 30 FPS. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
